fonts.telugu_support: Noto Sans Telugu, sans-serif (ensure to include for Telugu character support)

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-black
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl md:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-snug font-bold

rules: DO NOT USE Inter. Use Playfair Display for dramatic news headlines.
Ensure body fonts support Telugu script beautifully (e.g., Noto Sans Telugu or standard system fallbacks).
Category tags over images must be uppercase, tiny, with wide letter spacing.
Articles need high legibility: loose line-height (leading-relaxed) and dark ink text.
No purple gradients or generic tech aesthetics.
Use Bold Red (#DC2626) exclusively for breaking news accents, active states, and primary CTAs.
Use Deep Blue (#1E3A8A) for the main navigation bar to mirror traditional Telugu news channels.
Use 'Off-white paper' background (#F8F9FA) rather than stark #FFFFFF for the main app background to reduce eye strain, placing white only on specific cards/surfaces.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0. Use sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) for an authoritative, newspaper-like feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalistic. Avoid soft fluffy shadows. Use flat, crisp structures or hard-edged shadows if necessary.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid colors. DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds behind text. Headers must have a solid blue background. Cards must have solid white backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.dividers: Use prominent horizontal and vertical lines (border-b, border-r) to separate news items, mimicking print newspaper columns.

components_to_use: Shadcn UI Buttons (Sharp corners, solid colors)
Shadcn UI Dialog (For video popups or modals)
Shadcn UI Forms/Inputs (For Admin Dashboard, sharp edges)
Shadcn UI Tabs (For switching between Latest/Trending in sidebars)
react-fast-marquee (For Flash News Ticker at the top of the site)
lucide-react (For standard UI icons like search, menu, share)
sonner (For admin toast notifications, customized to be sharp and functional)

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Dense but structured. p-4 to p-6 inside cards. gap-4 to gap-6 between news blocks.

home_page.flash_news: Full width top bar (red background, white text) using react-fast-marquee.
home_page.header: Sticky nav with solid blue background. Logo on left, English categories (Sports, Cinema, etc.) in center.
home_page.main_grid: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 pt-6. Left side (col-span-8) for Bento grid of top stories (1 massive hero image, 4 smaller thumbnails). Right side (col-span-4) for Live TV widget and 'Latest Updates' scrolling list.

category_page.layout: Grid of news cards. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. First card can span 2 columns as a featured story.

article_detail.layout: max-w-7xl mx-auto grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 pt-6.
article_detail.content: col-span-1 lg:col-span-8. Huge H1, meta data (date/author), large hero image (max-h-[60vh] object-cover), optional embedded YouTube video, then body text.
article_detail.sidebar: col-span-1 lg:col-span-4. Related news and ad placeholders.

admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (dark blue or black) + Main content area.
admin_dashboard.style: High-density grid. border-collapse for tables. No soft styles. Function over form.
admin_dashboard.forms: Use Shadcn components. Fields for Title, Body (Telugu support), Category Dropdown, Image Upload (mock Emergent storage), YouTube URL, Publish Toggle.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Images should have a subtle scale effect (hover:scale-105 duration-300) wrapped in overflow-hidden. Text links should underline or change to primary red.
motion_and_interactions.flash_news: Continuous smooth marquee. Pause on hover.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use skeleton loaders matching the dense grid structure.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over images has a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent) on the lower half to keep headlines readable.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, and form inputs MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-sports-link', data-testid='admin-login-button').

sports.description: Cricket match action for Sports category hero

cinema.description: Movie theater scene for Cinema section

politics.description: Press conference podium for Politics/General News

live_tv.description: Breaking news studio set for Live TV widget placeholder

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a .js project, do not output .tsx files. Use standard React .jsx/.js syntax.
Build the Admin Dashboard routing carefully to allow for content creation (mocked backend for Emergent object storage is fine, but visually functional).
Implement the specific Telugu editorial aesthetic: red and blue primary colors, sharp corners, dense grid layouts.
Include Playfair Display and IBM Plex Sans via Google Fonts in index.html or global css.
Ensure the hero images have appropriate text-shadow or gradient overlays if text is placed on top of them.
Implement react-fast-marquee for the breaking news section at the top.
Do not use generic 'Inter' font. It destroys the editorial newspaper feel.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not center-align paragraph text. Left-align for reading flow.
Do not apply 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions like 'transition-colors' or 'transition-transform'.
No emojis as icons. Use lucide-react.
Always provide data-testid for key elements.
When building Shadcn components in .js, ensure prop types or default parameters handle missing props gracefully without TS.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath (like sticky navs). Use solid or heavy blurred backgrounds.
